verdict: Strong cost-per-lead, but spend pulled back and intake gaps need closing.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 122 leads at $11.90 each, entirely through Meta — and cost per lead actually improved 26% week-over-week even as ad spend dropped 33%, which means the budget that ran did so efficiently. The volume risk is real, though: fewer dollars in means fewer leads out, and daily lead counts have been uneven this past week. Separately, 40 of your 122 leads do not appear as opportunities in your CRM, and no appointments are logged — that points to a gap in how leads are being followed up after they arrive, not an ads problem. Phone-match attribution and contact cleanup are both being completed this week so the August scoreboard can be trusted before the end-of-month decision.
